title: Collection186: Celebrating Our Team Through Style and Design
summary: Shop Collection186, Target’s team member apparel collection featuring red styles from owned brands and exclusive designer-led drops.
body_markdown:
## Offerings & Availability


### June Launch


Collection186 launched online in June as an expanded assortment of red and khaki styles from owned brands, including **A New Day** and **Goodfellow** . This apparel lineup is available now at[Target.com/Collection186](https://www.target.com/c/collection-186/-/N-36eed) .


### October Design Drop


The next evolution of Collection186 launches Oct. 5 with a limited-edition Design Drop inspired by Isaac Mizrahi,[Target's Creative Director at Large](https://corporate.target.com/press/release/2026/06/target-teams-up-with-isaac-mizrahi-to-shape-the-future-of-accessible-design) .


Influenced by ideas from Isaac and insights from team members, Target designers created a new 16-piece collection that includes crew-neck tees, polos, track jackets, quilted jackets, cardigans, blazers, vests and more. The collection blends comfortability and function — things like flexible movement, moisture-wicking fabric, and snag-resistant designs — with embellishments like trendy pockets, collars, and buttons. Each item balances practicality with sophistication, affordability, and of course, the right red.


“Collection186 brings together so much of what defines Target — great style, design and value — with the realities of what our store team needs to wear every day,” said **Adrienne Costanzo** , chief stores officer. “Our team brings Target to life for our guests, and I love that they were at the center of how this collection came together. It gives them another way to express their personal style, feel confident and proudly represent our brand.”


> Our team brings Target to life for our guests, and I love that they were at the center of how this collection came together.
>
>
> Adrienne Costanzo
>
>
> Chief Stores Officer


The Collection186 Design Drop is available for preview now at[Target.com/Collection186](https://www.target.com/c/collection-186/-/N-36eed) . Team members can browse and save favorite items ahead of the launch in October. Some styles will be available in limited quantities and will not be replenished once sold out.


## Team member benefits


Collection186 provides options that fit the budget of all team members, with prices starting at $10. All standard team member discounts apply:


- 10% Team Member Discount
- 20% Owned Brand Adult Apparel & Accessories Discount
- Savings can be combined with the 5% Target Circle Card Discount


The Collection186 Design Drop is for team members only — guests are not eligible to purchase. To purchase items from the Design Drop, team members will need to be logged into Target.com using their Team Member ID.


Collection186 is an optional offering. Team members are not required to purchase work attire from Target and may wear any clothes that comply with company policy.
